title: Chapter 1113
text:
In a temporary military base of the Red Empire in the Ancient Star Desert.

Han Xiao's fleet was stationed here to replenish their supplies and repair their armor.

Over the past few months, based on the feedback from the black market network, he had wiped out the restless gray organizations in the Ancient Star Desert, successfully scaring the remaining people into not daring to take the risk. They chose to listen obediently and did not dare to touch the Virtual Mutiny Virus anymore. The environment in the Star Field had improved significantly.

The wipeout was very effective. While Han Xiao was on his way, he was also trying to find the virus core. He had Harrison activate the Luck Glow multiple times to select the virus' data intersection point.

However, this time, the Luck Glow was not able to find the virus core. Even old man Aesop could not predict the location of this thing. Han Xiao guessed that the virus core was probably another lover of the Goddess of Luck. Her tastes were really mixed.

He was responsible for eliminating the restless elements, while Manison was focused on research. Both sides had achieved results. Currently, the Intelligent Plague was under control for the time being.

"… I thought you guys would be able to make a three-piece antivirus set very quickly. I didn't expect it to take you a few months. This doesn't match your standards, Manison."

In the upper management lounge of the military base, Han Xiao was chatting with Manison's remote projection. While talking, he was munching on some kind of fruit seed that looked like a melon seed.

Manison shook his head. "It's not easy to decode the virus code. Plus, to prevent the virus from breaking out, we have to avoid the trigger mechanism. Therefore, we have to be careful, which took a lot of time."

A Beyond Grade A Virtual Mechanic could easily wipe out the Virtual Mutiny Virus with his own ability, but it was much more difficult to turn his ability into a universal tool. This was like an ordinary person who could naturally run and jump, but if he was asked to build a robot that could also run and jump, he would definitely be at a loss.

"What do the three Universal Civilizations plan to do now?"

"It's still the problem of the trigger mechanism. In order to prevent the virus from breaking out, we can't let the infection rate of the virus drop drastically. Therefore, even if we have a firewall, we can't use it on a large scale for the time being. We have to remove all the infected nodes before installing it. It's also because of this that the Virtual Mutiny Virus has infected more than half of the quantum network nodes in the Ancient Star Desert over the past few months despite the three Universal Civilizations trying their best to control it. "

"If I remember correctly, large-scale wiping out the virus will trigger a mine, right?" Han Xiao asked.

"That's right." Manison nodded. "Therefore, the scanning tool that the three Universal Civilizations requested us to create cannot be discovered by the virus. They plan to first use the scanning tool to secretly lock onto all the currently infected nodes, then accurately release the anti-virus tool to eliminate all the infected nodes at the same time. After that, they will immediately go online and install a firewall to prevent repeated infections. This way, even if the virus breaks out, the losses will be minimized."

"Although this method is a little troublesome, it's safe."

Han Xiao had no objections to the three Universal Civilizations' approach. It sounded quite reliable.

However, he had some doubts in his heart. Logically speaking, the three Universal Civilizations in his previous life also handled the situation in the same way, with a firewall as a barrier. How did it end up becoming a universal disaster?

Could it be that because I did a good job of cleaning up, I changed some unknown details? For example, someone tried to transport the virus out, but I stopped it now?

Han Xiao secretly suppressed this doubt in his heart.

Manison did not know what Han Xiao was thinking, so he continued to explain the three Universal Civilizations' plan.

"Therefore, we have two plans now. The first is to eliminate the virus in one fell swoop, and the second is to find the virus core. It's the control valve for most of the triggering mechanisms. As long as it's eliminated, the risk can be further reduced, and we won't have to worry about the virus breaking out."

"You guys still have no clue about the virus core?"

"It's hidden too well." Manison shook his head and did not reveal too much information.

Han Xiao snorted. He felt that old Manison was not telling the truth, but there was no point in exposing him. In this regard, the two of them were competitors, and the other party would not be kind enough to share clues.

All the Beyond Grade A Mechanics who came to help wanted to obtain the virus core and analyze the complete Virtual Mutiny Virus technology.

Now that the disaster was under control and the danger was over, the competition for the virus core gradually surfaced. Even the three Universal Civilizations had the intention to compete.

Han Xiao knew that he would not be able to get anything out of him, so he changed the topic and said, "Your research is done. Do you plan to stay in the research and development department?"

"No, I'm planning to go out and do some activities. On one hand, I'm looking for clues about the virus core. On the other hand, I plan to visit the Machinery Faith."

"Machinery Faith?" Han Xiao raised his brows.

He did not forget that the two of them had a conflict of interest in this regard. Manison had always occupied the position of the Lord God and wanted to monopolize the majority of the faith to maintain the bonuses of the (Key of Adeptus Mechanicus).

For this reason, Manison had taken the initiative to make a move more than ten years ago, causing Han Xiao to suffer a small loss.

Back then, he had chosen to use his soul talent and put aside the dispute, avoiding the spotlight and developing in a low-profile manner. Only then did they continue to interact.

"What, you have an idea?" Manison said with a half-smile.

"Humph, can't I?" Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

"Compared to ten years ago, you've improved. However, it's still too early for you to challenge me again." Manison said calmly, "Don't be greedy for what's mine. Our relationship is quite good now, and it's good for you to maintain the current state. Don't blame me for not reminding you. I don't want to see you have any form of contact with the Machinery Faith."

Then, the green remote projection disappeared, and Manison ended the call.

Han Xiao's face darkened, and he was a little annoyed.

This guy really has a dog's face, turning on me just like that.

Also, since when did the Machinery Faith become your property?

Shameless!

"Speaking of which, it's been more than ten years since the last time I fought with him …"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes, deep in thought.

He opened the interface and looked at the huge amount of EXP he had accumulated.

The Blackstar Cup had been going on for a long time, and it had been providing him with extra EXP for the past few months. Now, he had accumulated quite a lot. He did some calculations and estimated that it was enough for him to level up from 320 to 335-337.

With such a huge amount of EXP, as long as he took out a part of it, he would be able to max out all his Potential Points and level up all his Class Knowledges.

"After developing for so long, I feel like I can fight with Manison again …"

Han Xiao had avoided the spotlight for more than ten years in order to develop and accumulate strength. Now that he had achieved great results, his mind once again occupied the high ground.

The competition with the Machinery Faith was one thing, but to the current Han Xiao, another reason was the main reason.

I'm not convinced. I want to fight with Old Manison!

Last time, I was not as strong as him, but I've endured it. Revenge is a dish best served cold!

In the past, it was others who came knocking on my door and bullied my Philip. Now that we have some capital, it's my turn to take the initiative to challenge Old Manison and see the difference in strength.

Due to the existence of the Beyond Grade A Association, the strength of both sides would also affect the right to speak. Although Manison's term was still long, it was fine for him to make some preparations for the next election.

At the same time, because of the development union, he did not need to worry about Manison's retaliation. As the president, Old Manison had to set an example and not do anything in private, or it would go against the original intention of the development union.

Although Manison had helped him in the rescue of Hella, that was another matter altogether. Han Xiao would not accept the carrot for every blow. At most, he would find another chance to repay Manison's help.

Various thoughts flashed through his mind. Han Xiao opened the skill list, selected a batch of blueprint skills, and leveled them up to the maximum level. Notifications kept popping up on the interface.

One of your skills has been maxed out. You have received 1 Potential Point.

…

One of your skills has been maxed out. You have received 1 Potential Point.

Currently, Han Xiao was only three Ultimate Knowledges away from maxing out. [Ultimate Mechanical Engineering] was Lv. 3, [Mechanical Life Tinder] was Lv. 4, and [Endless Material Science] was Lv. 144 Potential Points were required. Even if he had some Potential Points in reserve, he would still need to max out more than a hundred skills.

The more skills he had, the higher the cost of leveling them up. Even low-level blueprints required a lot of Experience, but it was not as exaggerated as the cost of leveling up his character. This meant that although the players could take advantage of the loopholes, they could not go overboard. They still had to put in a lot of effort to obtain more Potential Points.

His Experience decreased rapidly, and more than half of it was used up very quickly. The remaining was only enough to level up to Lv. 326. Han Xiao only managed to gather 144 Potential Points.

Although leveling up would also give him Potential Points, he did not want to wait any longer. He had a lot of leeks and an endless supply of Experience. He did not need to be calculative.

Furthermore, Han Xiao was also very curious as to whether Potential Points would still be useful when all his knowledges were maxed out.

Looking at the huge sum of 144 Potential Points, Han Xiao took a deep breath and invested them all into the last three Ultimate Knowledges.

[Ultimate Mechanical Engineering] has been leveled up to Lv. 5 (max)!

[Mechanical Life Tinder] has been leveled up to Lv. 5 (max)!

[Endless Material Science] has been leveled up to Lv. 5 (max)!

All 60 of your Class Knowledges have been maxed out!

You have received [The First Sanctum] Ability Fragment x1.

You have received the talent [Great Machinery Sage]!

The Potential Points you currently possess and will obtain in the future will be converted into 'Awakening Points' in a 1: 1 ratio.

Usage 1: 1 Awakening Point can be converted into 100 Free Attribute Points (Irreversible).

Usage 2: 1 Awakening Point can be used to level up a maxed out skill by one level (Irreversible).

Usage 3: Increase the progress of the awakening of Unique Talents. Every 1 Awakening Point depends on the level of the Unique Talent (Irreversible). Also, 100 Awakening Points can be used to activate the embryonic form of a Unique Talent (Custom Talent Preference).

Usage 4: Increase the quality of blueprints. Every 1 Awakening Point depends on the level of blueprints and the quality of blueprints (Irreversible).

Usage 5: Increase the progress of blueprints. Every 1 Awakening Point depends on the level of blueprints and the quality of blueprints (Irreversible).

Your [Ultimate Mechanical Engineering] has been maxed out. Your ability [Inspiration Creation] has been activated!

"Woah!"

Han Xiao was pleasantly surprised.

As expected of a new talent brought by maxing out all his Class Knowledges. Not only did [Machinery Great Sage] provide all-rounded bonuses, but the increase was also very impressive. The increase to his combat strength was probably on the same level as [Perfect Mechanical Sense]. It could increase his overall combat strength by about ten percent, a step further.

Speaking of which, I wonder if all the maxed out talents for all five classes are 'Great Sage'?

Magic Great Sage? Sounds normal.

Psychic Great Sage? This is a little strange …

Esper Great Sage? Erm …

Martial Arts Great Sage? Forget it, it would be more appropriate to call it Muscle Great Sage.

The appearance of talents was still within Han Xiao's expectations, but the change in Potential Points gave him a pleasant surprise. In his previous life, no player had ever maxed out all the Class Knowledges, and this was the first time he had ever done so.

With all the Class Knowledges maxed out, his Potential Points became Awakening Points.

He carefully browsed through the introduction and became more and more excited. Compared to the simple use of Potential Points, Awakening Points were more useful.

Converting Free Attribute Points and increasing the upper limit of abilities were very practical, and there was no need to analyze them. He was more interested in the other three functions.

Increasing the quality of blueprints, this thing seemed to be able to produce Gold Grade blueprints.

For example, if he took a low-grade pistol blueprint and threw in Awakening Points, the blueprint's technical level would automatically increase. If he threw in enough Awakening Points, he might be able to turn this blueprint into a Gold Grade blueprint!

Furthermore, the type of blueprint wouldn't change much. From an ordinary pistol with elementary gunpowder technology, it would eventually transform into a high-energy portable planet-destroying weapon. It would be passed down in the same vein.

On the other hand, Awakening Points could also increase the research progress of blueprints, which was perfect for [Inspiration Creation].

[Inspiration Creation] had been gathering dust in the interface, and the prerequisite to activate it was max level [Ultimate Mechanical Engineering]. The effect of this skill was to consume EXP to combine an unlimited number of blueprints and randomly synthesize one or more improved or fused blueprints. At the same time, it could make advanced settings and choose the orientation of the synthesized blueprints, such as attack, defense, or control.

This skill was more stable than Free Manufacture, and it was the only way for players to spontaneously create Gold Grade blueprints. However, the probability of getting a finished product in one go was extremely low. Most of the time, they would only get the prototype of a Gold Grade blueprint or Inspiration Fragments, which could be used to increase the progress.

The last use of Awakening Points, which Han Technician valued the most, was to use them to synthesize Unique Talents!

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he muttered to himself,

"Old Manison, Sorokin, and the others' Unique Talents might have come from this."
